hints.title: Equilateral Triangle Cascade
hints.text: Any unit triangle with two colored neighbors automatically turns red.

hints.title: Periodicity in Rows
hints.text: The minimal set of red unit triangles follows a repeating 4-row construction.

hints.title: Top Tip and Chunks
hints.text: Handle the top tip based on n modulo 4, then color each subsequent 4-row group systematically.

hints.title: Constructive Grid Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all neighbor combinations is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) output size to store coordinate pairs.
